inputs.coverage: Published Jacobi-ellipsoid interpretation, with semiaxes 470 ±20, 383 ±10 and 245 ±8 km. The paper’s local projected-limb and opening angles do not provide a unique absolute surface attitude for this display. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
